blocks.prompt: 19 Find the general solution of the differential equation \(y - x\frac{dy}{dx} = 3\left(1 + x\frac{dy}{dx}\right)\).
blocks.explanation:
Pehli nazar mein yeh homogeneous lagta hai kyunke \(y - x\frac{dy}{dx}\) jaisi terms hain, lekin 3 jaisa constant homogeneous mein nahi aata.
Asal mein bracket khol kar \(\frac{dy}{dx}\) wali terms ikatthi karein to \(y - 3 = 4x\frac{dy}{dx}\) banta hai, jo seedha separable hai.
Diya kya hai? \(y - x\frac{dy}{dx} = 3(1 + x\frac{dy}{dx})\). Find kya karna hai? General solution.
Rule kaunsa? Separable equation ka tareeqa (Section 4.2.1): \(y\) ko \(dy\) ke saath, \(x\) ko \(dx\) ke saath, phir integrate.
Plan: bracket kholna, \(\frac{dy}{dx}\) ikattha karna, variables alag, integrate, log hatana.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(y - x\frac{dy}{dx} = 3\left(1 + x\frac{dy}{dx}\right)\).
Maloom karna: general solution.
Tareeqa: Separable equation: \(\frac{dy}{h(y)} = g(x)\,dx\) bana kar dono taraf integrate karna.

Bracket kholein aur \(\frac{dy}{dx}\) ikattha karein
\[y - x\dfrac{dy}{dx} = 3 + 3x\dfrac{dy}{dx}\]
\[y - 3 = 4x\dfrac{dy}{dx}\]
Kyun: 3 ko bracket ki dono terms se multiply kiya. Phir \(-x\frac{dy}{dx}\) ko right side par le gaye (jahan woh \(+x\frac{dy}{dx}\) ban gaya) aur 3 ko left side par: \(3x\frac{dy}{dx} + x\frac{dy}{dx} = 4x\frac{dy}{dx}\).
Dhyan dein: Bracket ke andar wale 1 ko bhi 3 se multiply karna hai; sirf \(x\frac{dy}{dx}\) ko multiply karna aam ghalti hai.

Variables alag karein
\[\dfrac{dy}{y - 3} = \dfrac{dx}{4x}\]
Kyun: Dono taraf \(4x(y - 3)\) se divide kiya (yeh maan kar ke \(y \neq 3\)). Ab left mein sirf \(y\) aur right mein sirf \(x\) hai. Yahi separable equation ka matlab hai: jaise bazaar se laye saman ko do alag tokriyon mein rakh dete hain, waise hi \(y\) wali cheezein ek taraf aur \(x\) wali doosri taraf.
Dhyan dein: \(4\) ko \(x\) ke saath neeche rakhna hai; agar \(4\) bhool gaye to jawab mein \(x^{1/4}\) ki jagah \(x\) aa jayega.

Integrate karein
\[\ln|y - 3| = \tfrac{1}{4}\ln|x| + \ln|C|\]
\[\ln|y - 3| = \ln\left|Cx^{1/4}\right|\]
Kyun: \(\int \frac{dy}{y - 3} = \ln|y - 3|\), aur \(\frac{1}{4}\) constant hai jo integral ke bahar aa jata hai. Log ka rule \(n\ln x = \ln x^n\) se \(\frac{1}{4}\ln|x| = \ln|x|^{1/4}\), phir \(\ln|C|\) ke saath mila diya.

Log hatayein
\[y - 3 = Cx^{1/4}\]
\[y = 3 + Cx^{1/4}\]
Kyun: Agar \(\ln A = \ln B\) ho to \(A = B\). Modulus hatane se jo \(\pm\) aata hai woh \(C\) mein shamil ho jata hai; aur \(C = 0\) se \(y = 3\) wala solution bhi isi mein aa jata hai. Yahan \(x > 0\) maana hai taa ke \(x^{1/4}\) real ho.

Tasdeeq
\[y' = \tfrac{C}{4}x^{-3/4}\]
\[4xy' = Cx^{1/4} = y - 3\]
Yani \(y - 3 = 4xy'\), jo di hui equation hi hai \(\checkmark\)
Kyun: \(x \cdot x^{-3/4} = x^{1/4}\). Jawab ko wapas equation mein rakha to dono taraf barabar ho gayin.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Answer key mein is sawal ka jawab number 22 par chhapa hai, 19 par nahi. Exercise 4.2 ki keys 2 se 29 tak hain jabke sawal sirf 25 hain (key 2 Question 1 ka jawab hai, aur keys 15, 19 aur 27 kisi chhape hue sawal ki nahi), is liye jawab 22 par dhoondiye, warna aap kisi aur sawal ka jawab dekh kar pareshan ho jayenge. Jawab khud, \(y = 3 + Cx^{1/4}\), sahi hai.
